translations.web: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
translations.bsb: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
translations.kjv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
translations.asv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
